correct_final.text: The argument is valid. Choose N as the maximum of the two epsilon/2 thresholds. For n>=N, |(a_n+b_n)-(a+b)| <= |a_n-a|+|b_n-b| < epsilon.

plausible_wrong_final.text: The argument is invalid unless both sequences converge at exactly the same rate, so an extra rate hypothesis is required.
